newsitem.title: USA: Marsh & McLennan launches insurance plan.
newsitem.headline: Marsh & McLennan launches insurance plan.

text.p: Marsh & McLennan Cos Inc said Monday it had launched a new insurance program giving money-market fund investors up to $100 million in protection against defaults by issuers of securities held by the funds.
Marsh & McLennan said the program will cover all money market funds that meet underwriting criteria.

It said the insurance is underwritten by major domestic insurers with the highest financial ratings available. The limit of each policy may be as high as $100 million, while the deductible may be set at the level desired by the fund, it added.
The company said it expected the program to attract not only mutual fund distributors but also institutions that offer money-market funds, such as commercial banks and investment-banking firms.
It said the new coverage could make money-market funds more appealing to investors by reducing a major fund risk.
